FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((affiliate_rate_bps IS NULL) OR ((affiliate_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (affiliate_rate_bps >= 0) AND (affiliate_rate_bps <= 900))))

CHECK ((((discount_kind = 'fixed'::text) AND (discount_value > 0) AND (discount_value <= 100000000) AND (max_discount_amount IS NULL)) OR ((discount_kind = 'percent'::text) AND (discount_value >= 1) AND (discount_value <= 9900) AND ((max_discount_amount IS NULL) OR ((max_discount_amount > 0) AND (max_discount_amount <= 100000000))))))
CHECK (((min_amount >= 0) AND (min_amount <= 100000000) AND ((max_redemptions IS NULL) OR (max_redemptions > 0)) AND ((per_buyer_limit IS NULL) OR (per_buyer_limit > 0))))
CHECK (((starts_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at < expires_at)))

CHECK (((list_amount > 0) AND (discount_amount >= 0) AND ((list_amount - discount_amount) = amount) AND (((discount_amount = 0) AND (coupon_id IS NULL) AND (coupon_code IS NULL) AND (coupon_snapshot IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'purchase'::text) AND (discount_amount > 0) AND (coupon_id IS NOT NULL) AND (coupon_code IS NOT NULL) AND (coupon_snapshot IS NOT NULL)))))

CHECK ((((refund_status IS NULL) AND (refund_destination IS NULL) AND (NOT refund_automatic) AND (refund_requested_at IS NULL) AND (refund_completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((refund_status IS NOT NULL) AND (refund_destination IS NOT NULL) AND (refund_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AND (refund_actor IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'purchase'::text) AND ((NOT refund_automatic) OR ((refund_destination = 'original'::text) AND (provider = 'xorpay'::text) AND (external_amount > 0))) AND ((refund_destination <> 'original'::text) OR refund_automatic OR (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM refund_note)) > 0)) AND (((refund_status = ANY (ARRAY['processing'::text, 'review'::text])) AND (status = 'failed'::text) AND (refund_automatic OR ((refund_status = 'review'::text) AND (refund_destination = 'original'::text) AND (external_amount > 0))) AND (refund_completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((refund_status = 'completed'::text) AND (status = 'refunded'::text) AND (refund_completed_at IS NOT NULL))))))
CHECK (((balance_amount >= 0) AND (external_amount >= 0) AND ((balance_amount + external_amount) = amount) AND ((balance_amount = 0) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth_passkey_enable_mfa()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE users SET two_factor_enabled=true WHERE id=NEW."userId";
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
